name: abdm-portal
description: Build and operate the ABDM Developer Portal: one Catalogue of NHA's three gateways (HIE-CM, UHI, NHCX) that renders as human documentation and compiles into agent skills, MCP surfaces and a plugin. Covers atom authoring, verification, linting, OpenAPI ingestion, Scalar docs, skill compilation, the update pipeline, the support agent, planning and proof.
